algorithm.json_serialization: sorted keys, finite JSON numbers, trailing newline

fixture.reference_channel: RX1 behind the 2-way branch and 10 dB attenuator

method.artifact_binding_limit: SHA-256 binds the raw bytes as observed during report generation; no external capture-time seal exists
method.delay_alias_note: 100 MHz full-grid sampling aliases delay every 10 ns; each 200 MHz training fold aliases every 5 ns, so a predeclared [-2.5,+2.5) ns physical prior selects one branch
method.delay_model: P_i(f)/P_ANT8(f) = A_i exp(j(phi_i - 2*pi*(f-f0)*tau_i)); positive tau means path i lags ANT8
method.model_cross_validation: two folds: even bins train/odd bins held out, then odd train/even held out
method.raw_replay: every NPZ is loaded with pickle disabled and the stored complex transfer is checked against a fresh pilot fit/projection
